nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bạn bè · bài tự soạn
L: Hey Ben, I'm really sorry about your birthday.
Honestly, I was pretty upset. I waited all evening.
I know. I totally forgot, and I feel awful about it.
You could have just texted me.
You're right. Let me make it up to you. Dinner is on me.
Fine, apology accepted. But I'm picking the restaurant.
Thanks for being honest. Let's forget about it.
I promise it won't happen again. I'll set a reminder.
Good. I'll hold you to that.

w: Hannah was rude to his friend
exq.why: “I'm really sorry about your birthday… I totally forgot” = Hannah quên sinh nhật Ben.

exq.q: What does Ben think Hannah should have done?
exq.why: “You could have just texted me.” = lẽ ra chỉ cần nhắn tin.
“Dinner is on me.” = bữa tối tớ trả (Hannah nói).

exq.q: What will Hannah do to avoid forgetting next time?
w: Write a note on her hand
Ask a friend to call her
exq.why: “I'll set a reminder.” = đặt lời nhắc.
